title: A new user's List hides the five optional columns by default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • View: on Work Orders the new user shows the List (click List in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar; its tooltip reads "List").
  • A brand-new user [User-N] who has never opened Work Orders, with a role that can see work orders (e.g. Technician). Name is an example ("Nora New").

Setup

  1. Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name, Last Name, an Email you can open > Role = Technician > Departments = Service > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > Save & Close. The new user accepts the invitation from that email and sets a password. Record the user as [User-N] (the case calls this user "Nora New").
  2. Check the setup worked: Settings > Staff lists [User-N]; [User-N] has not signed in or opened Work Orders before step 1.
custom_steps:
1. As [User-N], open Work Orders, click List in the display switcher and click the All tab.
  2. Write down every column heading.
  3. Click Column Selection and read which columns are off.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Invoiced Date, Days open, Parts, Returns and Waiting On Parts are not shown (5 columns off).
  • Every other column shows as it does in production today.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §2; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (§1 Business Case). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • QA handoff §2: “Hidden by default: Invoiced Date, Days open, Parts, Returns, Waiting On Parts.”
  • PRD §1 Business Case: “List remains the default and stays exactly as it is in production today; the only addition to the Work Orders page is the switcher that offers the two new displays.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
